description:
Create a new inventory category called 'Canvas Bags' and add 8 product variants of a Premium Canvas Tote bag. You must enter the exact details for each item:

1. Premium Canvas Tote - Small Natural (SKU: PCT-S-NAT, Retail: $18.99, Cost: $8.50, Stock: 25)
2. Premium Canvas Tote - Small Black (SKU: PCT-S-BLK, Retail: $18.99, Cost: $8.50, Stock: 25)
3. Premium Canvas Tote - Medium Natural (SKU: PCT-M-NAT, Retail: $24.99, Cost: $11.00, Stock: 30)
4. Premium Canvas Tote - Medium Black (SKU: PCT-M-BLK, Retail: $24.99, Cost: $11.00, Stock: 30)
5. Premium Canvas Tote - Large Natural (SKU: PCT-L-NAT, Retail: $32.99, Cost: $14.50, Stock: 20)
6. Premium Canvas Tote - Large Black (SKU: PCT-L-BLK, Retail: $32.99, Cost: $14.50, Stock: 20)
7. Premium Canvas Tote - XLarge Natural (SKU: PCT-XL-NAT, Retail: $39.99, Cost: $17.00, Stock: 15)
8. Premium Canvas Tote - XLarge Black (SKU: PCT-XL-BLK, Retail: $39.99, Cost: $17.00, Stock: 15)

Ensure all items are Taxable and assigned to the 'Canvas Bags' category.
